Technology stocks were softer in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing just over 2.3% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was falling slightly more than 1.6%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) DropCar ( DCAR ) is up 1.9% Thursday afternoon, yielding most of a more than 26% increase soon after the opening bell that followed the automotive logistics company completing the previously announced sale of its WPCS International subsidiary in Suisun City, Calif., for $3.5 million in cash.
In other sector news:
(+) Energous ( WATT ) was soaring nearly 74% higher on Thursday after the wire-less, radio-frequency powered devices company unveiled its first customer product to secure Federal Communications Commission approval: the WattUp-enabled personal sound amplification products from Delight.
(-) JinkoSolar Holding Company ( JKS ) slid almost 5% lower on Thursday. The photovoltaic panels manufacturer announced it was selected to supply solar modules for a 60-megawatt solar farm in Kampong Speu, Cambodia.
